reason: Internal only, and INERT on arrival: `[culture] enabled` defaults to false, so composition builds no adaptor, no schedule entry and no store, and landing this code changes nothing any deployed config.toml does on the next restart. Turned on, a Dreamer adaptor folds each room's own messages into one short account of what that room IS and why it became so — how they talk, how decisions get made, what they call themselves, and Nora's own standing there — once a day, appended to a chain. Nothing reads it, and that is the designed sequence rather than an unfinished state: the tier's one genuine contribution is the chain, because a model asked this question has no memory of its last answer, so any single account is a snapshot and a tier judged on its first snapshot is judged on the one thing it does not contribute. Nothing in the tier retires — no TTL, no closing condition, no supersede — because a quiet room's culture is not stale, it is accurate, and an old name does not become false, it becomes part of what the current one means. The body is free prose with no section schema, since a required-section shape could not have held a role a room invented for itself. A silent room does not fire. Nothing a member of a room can observe.
